scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w admin-client
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:generate
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w shared && npm run db:generate && echo Edit .env with your PostgreSQL credentials, create DB witchcraft_sim, then: npm run db:push && npm run content:sync && npm run db:seed
